system.summary: Clave Extra 3 (so named on LXVIII-1.14.1943.1). Two-figure groups 10-99 in a table read by the units figure: tens 1/2 = a0 b9 c8 d7 e6 f5 g4 h3 i2 j1; tens 3/4 = l0 ll9 m8 n7 ñ6 o5 p4 q3 r2 rr1; tens 5/6 = s0 t9 u8 v7 y4 z3 (51 -mente); 7x-9x are word groups (78 por, 82 enemigo, 87 para, 90 parque, 91 la, 96 de, 99 que; 88 and 97 not identified). The layout gives each letter two homophones, one per tens figure of its pair.
system.notes: distinct_symbols counts the 62 cells of the Clave Extra 3 key (key_frozen.tsv holds the 60 with a value); 29 distinct groups occur on this sheet, the word groups 3 times as 2 distinct groups (96, 99). Groups are joined by hyphens; runs are separated by clear words.

solution.what: LXVIII-1.2.56.1, 2.75.1, 7.890.1, 14.1943.1 (4 pages), 17.2435.1, 23.3148.1 and 23.3165.1 fetched from the CEHM image server one at a time, 2 s apart; 8.957.1-2 returned 404.

Pencil, a large loop drawn across the text. Two passes without the key (overview and 1:1 crops; fresh crops enlarged 1.6x): same group at 77 of 81 places, the 4 differences settled on the enlarged crops; F04 g11 has its first figure hidden under the loop. Blind check by the reviewer: 39 of 39 groups agree.

Clave Extra 3 key (targets/murguia1914/key_frozen.tsv, 60 entries) rebuilt from the contemporary pencil decipherment of LXVIII-1.14.1943.1 and frozen before this sheet was decrypted; copied unchanged into this folder. This sheet was not used to build or test the key.

Decrypted mechanically with key_frozen.tsv and read as sentences with every departure marked; scripts/check_marks.py passes (4 runs, 2 marks, 0 failures). 13 coded words: 11 verbatim, 2 with a marked changed value where the figure as read is one stroke off (F02 g10 24 for 26; F04 g11 12 for 42, first figure hidden). Per run verbatim: F01 4/4, F02 3/4, F03 2/2, F04 2/3.

Web searches (Pablo González 1913-1914 clave; cifrados constitucionalistas; Narváez, 'Algunos casos criptográficos del movimiento constitucionalista, 1914-1915', Historia Mexicana 75/2, 2025), repeated once by the reviewer on 13 Nov: no edition or decipherment of these documents or of Clave Extra 3. Narváez 2025 (403 to a script) and 2019, and M. W. González, Con Carranza (1933-34), not read.
Independent blind review by a second AI language-model agent (13 Nov 2026): 39 of 39 groups agree on its own crops, including the hidden figure of F04 g11; scripts reproduced; reading graded A.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py on validation.tsv, the mechanical values of the frozen key per group; scripts/validation_pairs.py): 81 read tokens, 29 types, es-modern order 4: reading -2.175 per letter; random keys mean -5.569, max -3.946 (z 6.0); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -2.591 (mean -2.675, z 6.0); annealer on the real text -2.295. Verdict: pass.

Integration check (13 Nov 2026): own decoder from key_frozen.tsv (nothing imported) gives the same four lines; scripts and docs/_validate.py re-run with the same figures (z 6.0, pass); key_frozen.tsv equals targets/murguia1914/key_frozen.tsv (PR #513) line for line. The freezing order rests on the contributor's record (one commit). Reading checked as sentences (a pay scale from private to colonel).

Integration check (13 Nov 2026): CEHM image LXVIII-1.17.2435.1.0001 fetched over plain http (no refusal) and every run compared at full resolution: about 78 of 81 groups agree; the second figure of F01 g2 (20 or 29), F02 g10 (24 where the sense needs 26) and the loop-hidden F04 g11 are the doubtful places. Strict share confirmed: 11 of 13 coded words verbatim (84.6%), read in part.

texts.label: Fuentes to González, Monterrey, 13 Jun [1914]
texts.summary: The chief of staff writes that the chiefs of forces draw pay at different rates (in some pay sheets the first captain is given $5.00, in others $4.00 or $3.00, and the same for the other officers) and proposes a uniform scale from private (one peso) to colonel (eight pesos), asking that González's decision be sent to all chiefs.
texts.note: 13 coded words in 4 runs: 11 verbatim from the signs (84.6%), 2 with a marked changed value ({g/e}l, establece{i/r}), the 2 repaired words count as not read. The clear text has no hole except the unread corner word; the coded words are a small part of it. The reviewer proposed read; the state is read in part because 84.6% of the coded words are verbatim, under the 95% bar.

reading_review.note: Three clean sentences; the coded parts fit the clear text exactly (haberes, papeletas, capitán primero, demás oficiales, uniformidad). Two marked one-figure repairs, both checked on the image.

gaps.detail: Hidden where the pencil loop crosses the line; read 12 as it shows, the sense needs 42.
The sheet shows 24 (g) where the sense needs 26 (e); a single occurrence, so a slip of the writer and a misread cannot be told apart.
Open at the top, 0 or 9; kept as 20 (a) because the word needs it; counted verbatim by the contributor, doubt recorded at the integration check.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.175; polyphony 0.0; 0 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.295
